title: Scotland's top scorers since 2000
brief: Name the ten players with the most goals for Scotland in full internationals since 1 January 2000, to the end of the 2026 World Cup. Only goals from 2000 on count.
period: Full internationals from 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026

notes.Shaun Maloney: Shaun Maloney, Robert Snodgrass, Lawrence Shankland and Kris Boyd have 7 each and share 10th; any of them fills it.
notes.Robert Snodgrass: Robert Snodgrass shares 10th on 7 with Maloney, Shankland and Boyd.
notes.Lawrence Shankland: Lawrence Shankland shares 10th on 7 with Maloney, Snodgrass and Boyd.
notes.Kris Boyd: Kris Boyd shares 10th on 7 with Maloney, Snodgrass and Shankland.
notes.James McFadden: McFadden is on 15 on Wikipedia (the SFA's count), 14 on Transfermarkt and 13 on RSSSF; he is 4th or 5th whichever is used.
notes.Ally McCoist: Ally McCoist's goals all came before 2000.
notes.Kevin Gallacher: Kevin Gallacher scored most of his 9 before 2000.
notes.Billy Dodds: Billy Dodds scored 3 of his 7 after 2000.

sources: https://www.transfermarkt.com/ceapi/performance-game/<player id> (every match a player played, filtered to the national team and the date window)
checks: Counted match by match from Transfermarkt's per-game data, 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026. Everyone in the ten made his debut after 2000, so their totals at the cut-off were checked against RSSSF (to 24 June 2026) and Wikipedia's list of Scotland internationals and records page: all agree except McFadden (15 Wikipedia, 14 Transfermarkt, 13 RSSSF) and Christie (10 Wikipedia and Transfermarkt, 9 RSSSF), neither of which changes the ten. Maloney, Snodgrass, Shankland and Boyd are on 7 in every source, so 10th is a pool. Straddlers (Dodds, Gallacher, Dailly, Hutchison) have 4 or fewer from 2000.
